name: interval
description: A lucid identity for a focus and rest app. Two separated bars, inky navy, and measured whitespace give a simple pause a meaningful visual presence.
heading: outfit
rules: The space between pause bars equals one bar width.
Let whitespace communicate rest instead of adding decorative calm imagery.
Use one concise message per view and keep secondary information small.

system.concept: Quiet light wells, precisely separated planes, softened navy-and-blue surfaces, and unusually open typographic rhythm. Restraint is a measurable design decision.
headline: A little space
between everything.
system.eyebrow: FOCUS / REST / A MORE USEFUL RHYTHM
features: One thoughtful step toward making more room in the day.
Simple practices with enough structure to become familiar.
An open, considered experience that keeps the essentials clear.
system.layoutNote: Centered, extremely open white hero with a small pause symbol and a broad light-well artwork. Two understated bordered cards; no dense decorative sections.
